questions.question: What is the function of hysteresis in a comparator?

choices.A: To prevent input noise from causing unstable output signals
choices.B: To allow the comparator to be used with AC input signals
choices.C: To cause the output to continually change states

questions.answer: To prevent input noise from causing unstable output signals

questions.question: What happens when the level of a comparator’s input signal crosses the threshold voltage?

choices.A: The IC input can be damaged
choices.B: The comparator changes its output state
choices.C: The reference level appears at the output

questions.answer: The comparator changes its output state

questions.question: What is tri-state logic?

choices.A: Logic devices with 0, 1, and high-impedance output states
choices.B: Logic devices that utilize ternary math
choices.C: Logic with three output impedances which can be selected to better match the load impedance

questions.answer: Logic devices with 0, 1, and high-impedance output states

questions.question: Which of the following is an advantage of BiCMOS logic?

choices.A: Its simplicity results in much less expensive devices than standard CMOS
choices.B: It is immune to electrostatic damage
choices.C: It has the high input impedance of CMOS and the low output impedance of bipolar transistors

questions.answer: It has the high input impedance of CMOS and the low output impedance of bipolar transistors

questions.question: Which of the following digital logic families has the lowest power consumption?
Why do CMOS digital integrated circuits have high immunity to noise on the input signal or power supply?

choices.B: The input switching threshold is about twice the power supply voltage
choices.C: The input switching threshold is about half the power supply voltage

questions.answer: The input switching threshold is about half the power supply voltage

questions.question: What best describes a pull-up or pull-down resistor?

choices.A: A resistor in a keying circuit used to reduce key clicks
choices.B: A resistor connected to the positive or negative supply used to establish a voltage when an input or output is an open circuit
choices.C: A resistor that ensures that an oscillator frequency does not drift
choices.D: A resistor connected to an op-amp output that prevents signals from exceeding the power supply voltage

questions.answer: A resistor connected to the positive or negative supply used to establish a voltage when an input or output is an open circuit

questions.question: In Figure E6-3, which is the schematic symbol for a NAND gate?
What is used to design the configuration of a field-programmable gate array (FPGA)?
In Figure E6-3, which is the schematic symbol for a NOR gate?
In Figure E6-3, which is the schematic symbol for the NOT operation (inversion)?
Which circuit is bistable?
What is the function of a decade counter?

choices.A: It produces one output pulse for every 10 input pulses
choices.B: It decodes a decimal number for display on a seven-segment LED display
choices.C: It produces 10 output pulses for every input pulse
choices.D: It decodes a binary number for display on a seven-segment LED display

questions.answer: It produces one output pulse for every 10 input pulses

questions.question: Which of the following can divide the frequency of a pulse train by 2?
How many flip-flops are required to divide a signal frequency by 16?
Which of the following circuits continuously alternates between two states without an external clock signal?
What is a characteristic of a monostable multivibrator?

choices.A: It switches temporarily to an alternate state for a set time
choices.B: It produces a continuous square wave
choices.C: It stores one bit of data
choices.D: It maintains a constant output voltage, regardless of variations in the input voltage

questions.answer: It switches temporarily to an alternate state for a set time

questions.question: What logical operation does a NAND gate perform?

choices.A: It produces a 0 at its output only if all inputs are 0
choices.B: It produces a 1 at its output only if all inputs are 1
choices.C: It produces a 0 at its output if some but not all inputs are 1
choices.D: It produces a 0 at its output only if all inputs are 1

questions.answer: It produces a 0 at its output only if all inputs are 1

questions.question: What logical operation does an OR gate perform?

choices.A: It produces a 1 at its output if any input is 1
choices.B: It produces a 0 at its output if all inputs are 1
choices.C: It produces a 0 at its output if some but not all inputs are 1
choices.D: It produces a 1 at its output if all inputs are 0

questions.answer: It produces a 1 at its output if any input is 1

questions.question: What logical operation is performed by a two-input exclusive NOR gate?

choices.A: It produces a 0 at its output only if all inputs are 0
choices.B: It produces a 1 at its output only if all inputs are 1
choices.C: It produces a 0 at its output if one and only one of its inputs is 1
choices.D: It produces a 1 at its output if one and only one input is 1

questions.answer: It produces a 0 at its output if one and only one of its inputs is 1

questions.question: What is a truth table?

choices.A: A list of inputs and corresponding outputs for an op-amp
choices.B: A list of inputs and corresponding outputs for a digital device
choices.C: A diagram showing logic states when the digital gate output is true
choices.D: A table of logic symbols that indicate the logic states of an op-amp

questions.answer: A list of inputs and corresponding outputs for a digital device

questions.question: What does “positive logic” mean in reference to logic devices?

choices.A: The logic devices have high noise immunity
choices.B: High voltage represents a 1, low voltage a 0
choices.C: The logic circuit is in the “true” condition
choices.D: 1s and 0s are defined as different positive voltage levels

questions.answer: High voltage represents a 1, low voltage a 0
